project_name: Haryana Enterprises - WhatsApp Smart Engine & Job/Solar Portal
archetype: The Swiss & High-Contrast Performance Portal (Government Job Hub + Solar Business)

text_sizes.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: Tetris Grid & Responsive Cards (1 col mobile -> 2 col tablet -> 3/4 col desktop)

whatsapp_smart_engine.format_template: 🔥 [Job Name] 🔥 | ✅ कुल पद: [Total Posts] | ✅ योग्यता: [Qualification] | 📅 आखरी तारीख: [Last Date] | 👇 लिंक: [Job Link]
whatsapp_smart_engine.copy_summary_feature: Auto-generated formatted summary card on Job Details & Admin Panel with 1-click Copy to Clipboard button and instant Toast notification.

cta_button.pulse_effect: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-white/20 before:animate-pulse

rank_math_card.score_gauge: Live SEO Score indicator (0-100) with color coding (Red <50, Orange 50-79, Green 80+)

seo_shuffler_and_rank_math.title_rotator_shuffler: Rotates synonyms (e.g. 'Haryana Govt Jobs', 'Sarkari Bharti Haryana', 'Latest Haryana Vacancy', 'HKRN Recruitment') to bypass duplicate content penalties on Google.

routes.name: Vacancy Listing Homepage
routes.description: Main homepage displaying government job listings with filters (Department, Qualification, District, Last Date), search bar, pagination (20 per page), featured job banners, and WhatsApp Channel banner.

routes.name: Job Detail Page
routes.description: Full job details, official notification links, qualification breakdown, Rank Math SEO meta, WhatsApp Summary Card with Copy button, and prominent 'Join WhatsApp Channel' CTA buttons.

routes.name: Solar Services Landing Page
routes.description: Dedicated solar business page with rooftop installation services, commercial solar solutions, solar subsidy calculator, photo gallery, testimonials, and quote inquiry form.

routes.name: Blogs Section
routes.description: Hinglish/Hindi articles regarding Haryana exam prep, HKRN updates, Solar government subsidies, and career guidance.

routes.name: Blog Article Detail Page
routes.description: Rich article reader with table of contents, author badge, social share buttons, and WhatsApp channel recruitment banner.

routes.name: Admin Panel
routes.description: Management dashboard with email/password auth, Manage Jobs (with Rank Math SEO + WhatsApp summary generator), Manage Blogs (rich text + image upload), Resume/CV Templates Uploader, and API Jobs Sync trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the full-stack portal with React frontend and FastAPI backend.
2. Ensure exact job summary format: 🔥 [Job Name] 🔥 | ✅ कुल पद | ✅ योग्यता | 📅 आखरी तारीख | 👇 लिंक.
3. Display exactly 20 job listings per page on the main Vacancy Homepage (`/`) with functional pagination controls.
4. Move the original/demo solar landing content to `/solar` and ensure 'Solar Services' is prominently linked in the Header and Footer.
5. Include 'Join WhatsApp Channel' buttons in Header, Footer, and on every Job Detail page pointing to `https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Va4Owji5Ui2bLEktCl1C`.

6. Build the Admin Panel (`/admin`) with login (simple email/password), featuring: Manage Jobs (with Rank Math SEO fields: custom title, focus keyword, meta description, live SEO score checker, and auto-generated WhatsApp summary preview with Copy button), Manage Blogs (rich text/markdown editor + cover image uploader), and Resume/CV Templates Uploader.
7. Implement SEO Title Shuffler logic for external/synced jobs so title and description variations stay unique and avoid Google duplicate content penalties.
8. Add a dedicated `/blogs` section with article listing and detailed blog view (`/blogs/:slug`).
9. Use Lucide icons (`lucide-react`) for UI elements and Sonner (`sonner`) for toast notifications when copying WhatsApp summaries or saving forms.
10. Attach `data-testid` to all interactive components as specified in the test_ids section.
